text:
Frederick Gaudreau was never drafted, went through Nashville, Pittsburgh and Minnesota, and at 33 is having the finishing run of his career in Seattle. Eight goals in 18 games, on 21 shots. That is a 38% shooting rate for a player who shot 10% last season, and his chances add up to 3.75 expected goals. Our numbers flag him as due to cool, and it's hard to argue.

None of that makes him a passenger. He's a checking center by trade: he kills penalties, has blocked 19 shots, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had 20% of his setups coming from behind the net last season, more than double a typical forward. Evolving-Hockey's verdict on his offense was blunt, bottom 4% of forwards in what his team created with him on, and the Kraken still get only 41% of the expected goals at five-on-five with him out there this year.

He ranks 121st in the league in wins added by goals, a nice return from a depth role. Enjoy the run; the shooting percentage is the thing to watch.
headline: Gaudreau's goals have outrun his chances
